summary: RelayTV is a containerised application designed to turn a Linux host connected to a television into a local media playback endpoint. It enables you to cast links from mobile devices, browse external media servers like Jellyfin or Emby, and control playback via Home Assistant or HTTP requests.
goodFor: It suits users seeking an open-source alternative to proprietary casting devices who want to integrate media playback into an existing Home Assistant automation setup.
watchOut: The repository currently has no tagged releases and zero recorded activity, indicating an early-stage or experimental project with potential stability risks.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker, you will typically need to map persistent storage for configuration data and ensure appropriate network access to your local media servers and television display.
